description: This file provides data access helper functions for a SpendSense dashboard, utilizing Supabase to fetch and process transaction, alert, and insights data. It includes utility functions for data normalization, date handling, and formatting, as well as exported functions that build and execute database queries with user scoping and filtering.

methods.name: toNumberOrNull(value)
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number or null if invalid.

methods.name: escapeForILike(input)
methods.description: Escapes special characters for case-insensitive pattern matching.

methods.name: buildOccurredAtBounds(dateRange)
methods.description: Builds date range bounds for querying based on input dateRange.

methods.name: sumAmounts(rows)
methods.description: Sums amounts from array of rows, normalizing values.

methods.name: formatMoneyUSD(value)
methods.description: Formats a number into a USD currency string.

methods.name: deriveTrendPercent(value)
methods.description: Calculates a trend percentage for UI visualization purposes.

methods.name: getUserContext({ userId, allowDemoUser = true } = {})
methods.description: Provides user context for RLS policies, with fallback to a demo user if none provided.

methods.name: requireSupabase()
methods.description: Ensures that the Supabase client is configured.

methods.name: fetchDashboardSummaryFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true } = {})
methods.description: Fetches KPI summary data for the dashboard for the current month.

methods.name: fetchRecentTransactionsFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, limit = 5 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches most recent transactions for activity feed.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsPageFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, page = 1, pageSize = 15, filters = {} } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of transactions with filtering options.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsSummaryFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, filters = {} } = {})
methods.description: Fetches summary statistics (total, average) of transactions based on filters.

methods.name: fetchInsightsSummaryFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, timeRange = "30d", segment = "Category" } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a lightweight insights summary over a specified time range.

methods.name: fetchAlertsFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, status = "all", severity = "all", limit = 25 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves alerts with status and severity filters.
